answer_1.quote: Therefore, in ElitePLM, we introduce several text generation tasks to evaluate the composition ability of PLMs, including story generation, text summarization, and question generation.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we adopt three automatic metrics, i.e., BLEU (Papineni et al., 2002), ROUGE, and METEOR.

answer_4.quote: we conduct human test from five aspects, i.e., Fluency, Informativeness, Accuracy, Relevance and Overall.
answer_4.guideline: Human judges scored each text on Fluency, Informativeness, Accuracy, Relevance, and Overall.
